summary: New sandbox start locations, skill VHS tapes, occupation balance tweaks, MapRemotePlayerVisibility extended to 4 values

changes.description: MapRemotePlayerVisibility sandbox option gained value 3 in 42.17 ('Friends and nearby users') -- mods with if/else chains for values 0-2 will silently miss the new case
changes.context: 42.17 added map remote player visibility = 3: faction members visible at any distance, others visible only when nearby and in line-of-sight. Mods that switch or compare against this var without a fallback for value 3 will silently ignore the new setting.

changes.description: 9 new skill VHS tapes added in 42.17 -- mods hardcoding VHS skill tape lists may be incomplete
changes.context: 42.17 added skill VHS tapes for: Aiming, Animal Care, Blacksmithing, Electrical, First Aid, Knapping, Pottery, Tailoring, Welding. Mods that enumerate or define VHS skill item distributions should include these new entries.
